question: ¿Cuántas transacciones hay en total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_transacciones FROM transactions;

question: Listar todas las cuentas activas
sql: SELECT code, name FROM accounts WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY code;

question: Mostrar el saldo de cada cuenta en pesos
sql: SELECT code, name, saldo / 100.0 AS saldo_pesos FROM accounts ORDER BY code;

question: ¿Cuáles son las 5 cuentas con mayor saldo?
sql: SELECT code, name, saldo / 100.0 AS saldo_pesos FROM accounts ORDER BY saldo DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Mostrar las cuentas de naturaleza deudora
sql: SELECT code, name FROM accounts WHERE nature = 1 ORDER BY code;

question: Listar las transacciones cerradas
sql: SELECT trans_id, date, legend FROM transactions WHERE status = 2 ORDER BY date DESC;

question: Mostrar las transacciones por verificar
sql: SELECT trans_id, date, legend FROM transactions WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY date DESC;

question: Contar transacciones por estado
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS cantidad FROM transactions GROUP BY status;

question: Mostrar el total del debe y del haber de cada transacción
sql: SELECT t.trans_id, SUM(e.debit) / 100.0 AS total_debe, SUM(e.credit) / 100.0 AS total_haber FROM transactions t JOIN transaction_entries e ON t.trans_id = e.trans_id GROUP BY t.trans_id;

question: Mostrar las líneas de debe y haber de la transacción 5
sql: SELECT a.code, a.name, e.debit / 100.0 AS debe, e.credit / 100.0 AS haber FROM transaction_entries e JOIN accounts a ON e.acc_id = a.acc_id WHERE e.trans_id = 5;

question: Listar transacciones creadas por el usuario con email juan@example.com
sql: SELECT t.trans_id, t.date, t.legend FROM transactions t JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.email = 'juan@example.com' ORDER BY t.date DESC;

question: ¿Cuántas transacciones creó cada usuario?
sql: SELECT u.name, COUNT(*) AS total FROM transactions t JOIN users u ON t.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.user_id, u.name ORDER BY total DESC;

question: Mostrar las transacciones del año 2024
sql: SELECT trans_id, date, legend FROM transactions WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2024' ORDER BY date;

question: Contar transacciones por mes en 2024
sql: SELECT strftime('%m', date) AS mes, COUNT(*) AS cantidad FROM transactions WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2024' GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes;

question: Mostrar las transacciones de los últimos 30 días
sql: SELECT trans_id, date, legend FROM transactions WHERE date >= date('now', '-30 days') ORDER BY date DESC;

question: Total movido al debe por cada cuenta
sql: SELECT a.code, a.name, SUM(e.debit) / 100.0 AS total_debe FROM transaction_entries e JOIN accounts a ON e.acc_id = a.acc_id GROUP BY a.acc_id, a.code, a.name ORDER BY total_debe DESC;

question: Cuentas que nunca se usaron en transacciones
sql: SELECT code, name FROM accounts WHERE acc_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT acc_id FROM transaction_entries);

question: Listar los libros diarios ordenados por fecha
sql: SELECT ledger_id, date, transactions_count, total_debit / 100.0 AS total_debe, total_credit / 100.0 AS total_haber FROM daily_ledgers ORDER BY date DESC;

question: ¿Cuántos libros diarios hay por grupo?
sql: SELECT "group", COUNT(*) AS cantidad FROM daily_ledgers GROUP BY "group";

question: Listar los usuarios activos
sql: SELECT name, email FROM users WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY name;

question: ¿Cuál es la última transacción registrada?
sql: SELECT trans_id, date, legend FROM transactions ORDER BY date DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Suma total del debe de todas las transacciones cerradas
sql: SELECT SUM(e.debit) / 100.0 AS total_debe FROM transaction_entries e JOIN transactions t ON e.trans_id = t.trans_id WHERE t.status = 2;

question: Mostrar el saldo total de las cuentas activas por naturaleza
sql: SELECT nature, SUM(saldo) / 100.0 AS saldo_total FROM accounts WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY nature;

question: Listar las 10 transacciones con mayor monto al debe
sql: SELECT t.trans_id, t.date, SUM(e.debit) / 100.0 AS total_debe FROM transactions t JOIN transaction_entries e ON t.trans_id = e.trans_id GROUP BY t.trans_id, t.date ORDER BY total_debe DESC LIMIT 10;
